summary: Expectations are derived from the supplied program specification. This document does not execute tests or import old pass results.

assumptions.text: FIXTURE ONLY. Supplied header/mock model a bounded immediate call: returns 0 and writes an arbitrary representable int on success; nonzero on failure, with output unspecified. Call exactly once after pointer validation. No allocation, blocking, lock, or real device access is modeled.
Independent states may be used by independent callers; external API synchronization is outside this fixture.

static_checks.title: Fixture-only API boundary
static_checks.method: Review exact locked source and supplied synthetic API contract; follow null checks before the API call.
static_checks.criterion: No API call/write before pointer validation; only the supplied immediate API contract; no invented ABI, allocation, loops or shared mutable state.
